newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish CIE/Esat Telecom plan fibre optic business.
newsitem.headline: Irish CIE/Esat Telecom plan fibre optic business.

text.p: Irish private telecommunications company Esat Telecom and national transport company CIE Group on Monday announced they plan to form Ireland's first ever independent fibre optic telecommunications company.
In a joint statement they said initial negotiations for the new joint venture had been signed by CIE chairman Michael McDonnell and Esat chairman Denis O'Brien (Esat).
The independent fibre optic telecommunications network will be set up to service the corporate and residential markets in Ireland, the statement said.

Fibre optic cable will be carried along CIE's existing rail network and this will be used to provide a range of telecommunication services to a wide variety of customers in the marketplace, the joint venture companies said.
Construction will start in August and is expected to be completed and operational in 1998, they said.
